description: This source file defines Express.js routes for managing 'projects', including CRUD operations, project overview, and user usage data. It interacts with database models, controller factories, and analytics services to provide RESTful API endpoints.

methods.name: router.get('/', ...)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all projects via a generic controller.

methods.name: router.get('/:id', ...)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific project by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/', ...)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project.

methods.name: router.put('/:id', ...)
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a project by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id', ...)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/overview', ...)
methods.description: Provides a comprehensive overview of a specific project, aggregating project info, ownership, costs, durations, and user-specific usage data.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/users/usage', ...)
methods.description: Returns per-user cost and session duration details for a specific project.
